tested_features: 10% attrition rounded up per nonempty stack
rolling four daily snapshots of garrison troop power
deterministic repeat under reversed request order
limitations: The combat formula is an intentionally invented deterministic toy and NOT the Jactari automatic combat algorithm
Attack travel, siege, hero status, recruitment queues and spells are absent
Reinforcements happen in toy immediate commit without modeled travel
Relic owner capture or recapture did not occur in the demonstration
City-level bonus is a synthetic 6500 power per level; its true historical relationship is not validated
Sphinx/Treasury bonus valuation and net ROI are not yet tested in this engine
No population 70% scenario in V5.2: unit tests only
Python scripts are included in linked conversation ZIP; not published as repository source
result: V5.2 successfully establishes a reproducible correctness baseline rather than a balanced tactical war.
